title: Orbina V2.4 synthetic local digital elevation test
reference: Upper broad candidate continental landmass, region 2, coastline from orbina-v23-relative-elevation-relief.svg
method: Point-in-polygon center masking; procedural elevation with coast distance, curved Gaussian ridge and deterministic trigonometric texture; coastal cells sea-level outlets; Priority-Flood fill with 0.15 m per cardinal 6-map-unit cell (0.212 m diagonal); 8-neighbor directed drainage tree and reverse-order flow accumulation.
physical_scale_note: Map units are drawing coordinates, not kilometres. Absolute elevations are artificial scenario values, not Orbina measured heights or approved canon.
